dct_title_s: King County, Washington : Metro Transit centers
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Metro Transit centers.

Purpose: This data set consists of transit facilities with high-density transit service used as transfer points by transit passengers. They may or may not be associated with a park-and-ride lot. The points are used to determine distances to calculate platform hours vs revenue hours of service. They are also used by web-based trip planning service.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
